explanation: Only the 22 stores that opened before 2023 count. Almere opened on 1 September 2024, less than 12 full months before 1 October 2024, so it is left out, as are Mechelen (new) and Zwolle (closed). LFL growth = 100 × (7.80 - 7.50) / 7.50 = 4.0%. Counting every store gives about 5.4%, which mixes in the openings and the closure.
